README.txt.author: SOFTCOM
README.txt.content:
--------------------
Level 1
--------------------

The target configuration credentials have been indexed across a horizontal 
network of storage archives and data partitions.

Checking every single sub-directory one by one is highly inefficient. Instead, 
you can leverage global pattern scanning to find the target data instantly.

The 'grep' command can scan all subfolders and assets recursively if you append 
the '-r' flag. This isolates lines matching your keyword without manual navigation:
  grep -r "keyword" .

Commands Available:
  cd, ls, ls -a, cat, grep

Locate the initialization token to proceed.
